visual.general_description: Two side-by-side axial contrast-enhanced CT images of the upper abdomen showing a large heterogeneous liver mass with one red arrow on the left image and three blue arrows on the right image.
visual.detailed_description: Two axial CT slices of the upper abdomen, grayscale, with the spine at the bottom centre and the stomach and spleen at the right of each image. In the left image a very large, low-attenuation (dark) mass with a lobulated, enhancing rim occupies most of the visible liver; a red arrow points at the lateral edge of the large central hypodense component, and smaller dark nodules lie beside it. In the right image, a slice at a different level, the liver contains a cluster of smaller rounded hypodense lesions with enhancing walls near the midline; three blue arrows point at three of these peripheral satellite lesions. Contrast is visible in the aorta, and the spleen shows heterogeneous enhancement. The images carry no printed letters, scale bar, measurement overlay, patient text or date text, and the arrows are coloured red and blue.

visual.general_description: Two side-by-side H and E stained microscopy fields of liver core biopsy tissue at low and higher magnification showing pink stroma with scattered atypical cells.
visual.detailed_description: Left field: a low-power view of a pale pink tissue fragment with a smooth edge at the right and a white background beyond it; the tissue is pink fibrous stroma with scattered small purple nuclei and a few cell clusters, and a small blue-green smudge sits at the upper left of the fragment edge. Right field: a high-power view of pink eosinophilic material containing irregular nests and clusters of larger polygonal cells with enlarged, variably dark purple nuclei, some with clear halos and some with prominent nucleoli, set in a pink stromal background with whorled pink areas. No letters, scale bars, arrows, text or patient identifiers are visible.

visual.general_description: Two side-by-side immunohistochemistry fields of liver core biopsy tissue with brown chromogen staining of cell membranes and clusters on a pale background.
visual.detailed_description: Left field: a diagonal strip of tissue on a pale cream background with orange-brown staining outlining cells and glandular or nested structures across most of the fragment; the intensity is moderate and fairly uniform, with the lower right showing the densest brown outlines. Right field: a similar diagonal strip of tissue with brown-red staining that outlines cell borders and rings, denser in the left-central part of the fragment and in the lower right, with scattered pale unstained areas and a few detached fragments at the upper margin. No letters, scale bars, text, arrows or patient identifiers are visible.
